verdict.rationale: Data residency and region selection is a fair axis for a hosted SaaS billing platform like Stripe Billing, so the story applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions choosing a storage region, data residency, or data localization; the items cover subscriptions, invoicing, retries, migrations, webhooks, MCP, and pricing only.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
